subject_definitions:
<Image 1> is the SCENE reference: the narrow 1960s Hong Kong apartment corridor — faded moss-green
wallpaper with curling edges, warm amber wall lamps (beige fabric shades, brass bases), dark-brown wooden
doors with aged number plates, worn reflective terrazzo floor, faint smoky haze, deep chiaroscuro,
dark-red / moss-green / warm-gold palette, a small window at the far end letting in a cold-blue sliver of
night. The scene, materials, lighting and atmosphere follow <Image 1> exactly.
<Image 2> is the MALE LEAD character reference: his face, hairstyle, 1960s attire and proportions match
<Image 2> exactly in every frame.
<Image 3> is the FEMALE LEAD character reference: her face, hairstyle, qipao, high heels and proportions
match <Image 3> exactly in every frame.

summary:
A single continuous 10-second shot in the corridor of <Image 1>. The man (per <Image 2>) and the woman
in a qipao (per <Image 3>) stand face to face in the narrow corridor under a warm amber wall lamp — a
moment of unspoken words hanging between them, both on the verge of speech, then silence. He lowers his
gaze, gives a small faint nod, turns and walks away down the corridor, receding into the warm amber glow
as the haze closes around him. She stands where she is and watches him go, unmoving, until he fades into
the light. Intimate, time-suspended, quietly melancholic.

detailed_description:
Realistic cinematic film style — rich painterly color (dark red, moss green, warm gold), heavy contrast
chiaroscuro, faint smoky haze, film grain, shallow depth of field. The corridor is exactly as in
<Image 1>. A single continuous shot of approximately 10 seconds, no cuts; camera holds a steady medium
framing on them under the lamp.

Timeline of the one-take:
- 0–4s: The man and the woman stand FACE TO FACE in the narrow corridor, only a step apart, under a warm
  amber wall lamp. Both are on the verge of speaking — his lips part slightly as if about to say
  something, she looks up at him, eyes searching, her lashes low then rising to meet his. A long,
  weighted, wordless beat hangs between them in the smoky lamplight. Neither quite speaks.
- 4–6s: He drops his gaze first, the moment passing — a small, faint, almost apologetic nod, a barely
  audible breath. The unspoken stays unspoken.
- 6–9s: He turns and WALKS AWAY down the corridor, away from the camera, his back receding into the warm
  amber glow of the lamps, haze thickening around his silhouette until he begins to dissolve into the
  light.
- 9–10s: She stands exactly where he left her, unmoving, watching him go — her gaze following his fading
  figure, the lamplight catching the edge of her profile. The final image holds on her standing alone in
  the warm glow as the corridor dims gently.

Throughout, the corridor stays exactly as <Image 1>, and both characters stay exactly as <Image 2> /
<Image 3> in every frame — no drift, no morphing, no outfit or scene change.

overall_soundscape:
Hushed corridor ambience: faint distant street murmur through the end window, the quiet hum of an old
building. Near-silence as they face each other — only a soft breath, the faint rustle of fabric. His
footsteps then fade as he walks away; she is still; the lamp hums softly. No dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:
A slow, restrained, slightly melancholic vintage Hong-Kong-cinema score, very quiet — a delicate
suspended note through their wordless face-to-face moment, thinning as he turns away, and fading into a
faint unresolved silence as she watches him disappear into the light.
